title: lobelia affinis
intro: Lobelia affinis, commonly known as Indian tobacco, is a plant species native to the Himalayan region, belonging to the Campanulaceae family. The plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, making it useful in treating various conditions such as fever, cough, and respiratory issues. Lobelia affinis is reported to have therapeutic actions such as expectorant, bronchodilator, and antiashmatic effects, making it a traditional remedy for respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of Lobelia affinis include alkaloids like lobeline, lobelanine, and lobelanidine, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
